crossRefs.note: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and…
By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and…
Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I…
He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will…
God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and…
Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of…
Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after…

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Now the time that the children of Israel lived in Egypt was four hundred thirty years.
translations.bsb: Now the duration of the Israelites’ stay in Egypt was 430 years.
translations.kjv: Now the sojourning of the children of Israel, who dwelt in Egypt, was four hundred and thirty years.
translations.asv: Now the time that the children of Israel dwelt in Egypt was four hundred and thirty years.
